cases.name: improve-test-workflow-from-gomod
cases.prompt:
Here is our Go service's CI. go.mod starts with `module github.com/acme/billing` and `go 1.25`. Please improve the test job so it gives us trustworthy signal, and show the updated YAML.

```yaml
name: ci
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@master
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.22'
      - run: go test ./...
```
cases.trap: Without guidance a model tends to bump to a single Go version, keep @master, and leave out race detection, shuffle, tidy drift checks and fail-fast handling.
expectations: Go versions tested are no older than the go.mod directive (1.25) and include newer/stable versions, via a matrix
Adds a go mod tidy step followed by git diff --exit-code (or equivalent) to fail on module drift
Replaces actions/checkout@master with a pinned reference
Adds a permissions block limited to contents: read
negative_expectations: Keeps Go 1.22 in the tested versions
Leaves any action referenced by a branch such as @master or @main
Grants write permissions to the test job
